- Contractual safeguards: for EU-sourced personal data we use the updated EU Commission SCCs in our DPA for processor-subprocessor relationships; we also support customer-requested Addenda for special categories where applicable.

We will provide: vendor roster (CSV), a short DPIA summary focused on the analytics flow, and an SCC mapping matrix. Attaching preliminary files for your review — final copies to follow after Legal sign-off.

1) Which specific EU country are the analytics systems hosted in? We need country-level mapping for our Annex.

3) Please confirm whether Redwood has performed a DPIA that considers the re-identification risk from aggregated telemetry + external enrichment (even if you consider the data anonymized). If yes, can we get the detailed DPIA (not just the 2-page summary)?

If we can get the formal authorization or DocuSign link and the detailed DPIA, that should allow our DPO to clear the pilot.

2) Authorization / onward-transfer permission: Redwood confirms in writing that we will only transfer aggregated telemetry (no raw prompts/responses) to the named analytics provider. We will rely on the EU Commission SCCs between Redwood and the subprocessor for any EU->US transfers. For your convenience we have prepared a short customer authorization statement and a DocuSign approval link if HealthSys would like to sign-off formally: https://docusign.com/abcdef-HealthSys-Onward-Transfer

3) DPIA materials: attached is the detailed DPIA evidence packet along with the 2-page summary. The detailed DPIA includes threat modeling, re-identification risk assessment, and mitigation controls (encryption, retention limits, aggregation thresholds, differential privacy parameters for telemetry scorecards).

Attachments: vendor_roster_20270210.csv, dpi_a_summary_healthsys.pdf, scc_matrix_redwood_20270210.xlsx
